gt_provenance.details: Official PDF/HTML-derived ground truth; model-authored cards are disclosed as auxiliary input material, not independent labels.

construct_measurement.details: Deterministic event F1 measures the task construct; semantic-card channel is model-authored but cross-model-qualified.

data_event_support.details: 86 turns, 79 speakers, 742 roster entries, 21 languages, 86 cards; boundary/media support documented.

model_role_fitness.details: LLMs are solvers/material auditors; scorer is deterministic; roles are separated.

baseline_independence.details: Baselines and controls are present; scripted perception/card baseline is diagnostic/design-hardening evidence, not confirmation.

identification_assay_sensitivity.details: Oracle/empty anchors, five degraded ablations, semantic ceiling, and frame-dump controls exercise assay sensitivity.

evaluator_qualification.details: Primary evaluator is deterministic; semantic-card material audits are disclosed and corrected.

information_statistical_adequacy.details: Adequate for a benchmark gate; no uncertainty/power basis for broad robustness or population claims.

leakage_fresh_evidence.details: Internet disabled, proxy sealed, raw trajectory/proxy audits retained, public-oracle probe blocked.

result_computation_integrity.details: Standard F1, no self-normalization; reported reward files and immutable raw package exist.

scope_claim_alignment.details: GPT-first checker passes; Opus 0.116279 exceeds nominal README <0.10; harness/source substitutions are explicit maintainer waivers.
